The statement-cache branch's literal .first() lives in the extracted _loadSingularViaStatementCache helper (associations.ts).

findTarget is the macro dispatcher; the scope construction Rails does inline lives in the two private arms it delegates to (_findBelongsToTarget / _findHasOneTarget), which call _builtAssociationScope / _scopeForAssociation.
